visual_action: A montage shows various clips of people celebrating outdoors in city streets. Crowds of people are dancing, cheering, and waving signs and flags for "Biden Harris". The scenes appear to be from daytime gatherings and street parties. Many people in the crowds are wearing face masks.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "...what it felt like to beat Trump last time".

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: His name appears on numerous signs and flags reading "BIDEN HARRIS" and a t-shirt reading "Cubanos con BIDEN".

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Her name appears on numerous signs and flags reading "BIDEN HARRIS".

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official account for the Democratic Party, @democrats.

on_screen_text.text: just a reminder, this is what it felt like to beat Trump last time 🙌💙

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of the lyrics from the song "Celebration" by Kool & The Gang, including the lines "Celebrate good times, come on!"
audio_music: The song "Celebration" by Kool & The Gang plays throughout the video. It is an upbeat, energetic, and celebratory funk/disco track that reinforces the joyful and triumphant mood of the visuals.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of different clips with quick cuts between various scenes of celebration.
central_claim: The victory over Donald Trump in the last election was a moment of widespread public joy that should be remembered and recreated.
intended_effect: To evoke nostalgic and positive feelings about defeating Donald Trump and motivate viewers to vote for Democrats again.
